about: The one rule for a client's own bookings, read by BOTH test suites: web tests/client-booking-rule-table.test.ts and mobile test/unit/client_booking_rule_test.dart. A rule changed on one surface turns that surface red; a row changed here turns both red until both follow. docs/design/web-account-bookings-truth.md §2.1 and §2.8; consumer-app-truth.md §2.7; decisions 165, 166, 186.

fields.status: the stored status, as the API spells it
fields.minutesFromNow: the booking's time minus now, in minutes (0 = exactly now, which is past)
fields.tab: upcoming (« À venir ») · past (« Passés ») · cancelled (« Annulés »)
fields.label: the chip's words
fields.tone: warning · success · neutral · error (the app's AppChipTone names)
